content.title: Stifel CEO Bats Down Idea Company Is for Sale
content.summary: Stifel  CEO Ron Kruszewski wants to be clear: His company isn’t for sale.  Kruszewski told employees just that in a memo on Wednesday, stating that a recent news article that said the company would consider a sale to a rival was “ridiculous and misleading.”  Kruszewski’s comments come a week after he was asked by BMO Capital Markets analyst Brennan Hawken during an earnings call if he would consider selling the company given that it is an “attractive asset.”
